What Ensign Group says to expect

  • Full year 2026: earnings per share and revenueDue to the strength of the third quarter and our confidence in the fourth quarter, we are increasing our annual 2026 earnings guidance to $7.94 to $8.02 per diluted share, up from our original guidance of $7.75 to $7.85. We are also raising the lower end of our annual revenue guidance to $5.89 billion, while maintaining the upper end at $5.92 billion.
